name: BN5 in both pair cores, two clients
result: The same installs' record on both (1,913,709 bytes, 132 hooks) and the same ready hash; Alpha's MrkCan1 took Beta from 100 to 30 on both screens, every hash agreeing to the end; a desync and two records apart each stopped both.
meaning: Two games with BN5's ROM make byte-identical pairs from their own ROMs; a difference in the installs is caught at the ready.
